按笔记发送：同一笔记使用同一 AI 连接的字段合并请求，减少重复输入。逐字段发送: Per note: fields using the same AI connection share one request, reducing repeated input. Per field: each target field gets its own request. Prompts can reference several {{field names}}; switching connections preserves your prompt.
Markdown 将标题、表格和列表等内容转换为卡片可显示的 HTML。CSS:
Markdown turns headings, tables and lists into card HTML. CSS injection is off by default and focuses on table formatting.

Selected note types share global CSS. Styles are injected only after a query actually writes a note successfully. Saving settings or a query with no changes does not inject styles. Only the add-on’s marked block is updated; other CSS is retained and identical content is not duplicated.
只处理启用后新增笔记的空字段，使用对应类型的星标配置；没有有效星标时使用首份配置:
Processes empty fields of notes created after enabling this feature, using the note type’s starred configuration or its first configuration as fallback. Only selected types are checked. A tick is skipped if the previous batch is still running. Stops when Anki closes.

Cancel the countdown to skip that batch; otherwise it starts automatically. This does not regenerate all older notes.
线程数控制词典查询并行量，不改变 AI 的每分钟发送数。媒体模糊匹配用于严格路径:
Threads control dictionary concurrency, independently of the AI request rate. Fuzzy media matching tries similar resource names when exact paths fail and may choose an identically named resource. If audio is missing, check MDD/resources first, then send HTML, JS and the original parser to AI for path analysis.

%s represents the word in the cloze format; {0} represents the media filename in the sound format. Retain these placeholders when editing.
每分钟发送数：所有 AI 连接共用，按间隔平滑发送，未发送的请求排队等待。\n\:
Requests per minute: shared across AI connections and sent at even intervals; unsent requests queue.

Connect timeout limits connection setup. Request timeout controls waiting for a service response.

Retries are additional attempts for rate limits and temporary server errors; zero disables them. Authentication and parameter errors are not retried, and network timeouts are not blindly resent.

Dictionary paths, MDX/MDD files, dictionary JavaScript, conversations and recycled scripts are excluded. Old scripts stay on this device for seven days; a restored version participates in backup only after becoming the current script.

API keys are included as plaintext by default. Uncheck the option to exclude them while retaining local keys. Importing missing keys does not clear local credentials. Export includes this page’s unsaved values without saving them locally or closing the page.

DeepSeek Responses 使用 reasoning.effort；n: DeepSeek Responses uses reasoning.effort: none disables thinking, while high requests higher reasoning effort. Supported values depend on the model.
DeepSeek Chat 使用 thinking.type 开关思考，reas: DeepSeek Chat uses thinking.type to toggle thinking and reasoning_effort to set its intensity.
Qwen Responses 使用 reasoning.effort；none: Qwen Responses uses reasoning.effort: none disables thinking. Support for high and other levels depends on the model.
Qwen Chat 使用 enable_thinking 开关思考。: Qwen Chat uses enable_thinking to toggle thinking.
百炼地域或业务空间可能使用专属域名，请填写控制台对应的完整地址。: Model Studio regions or workspaces may require a dedicated domain. Enter the full endpoint shown in your console.
AI 配置已保存，但旧配置清理失败，请检查旧文件权限。: AI settings were saved, but legacy cleanup failed. Check the old file permissions.
API Key 仅存本机系统凭证库，不参与同步和备份。: API keys stay in the local OS credential vault and are excluded from sync and backups.
填写完整 API 地址，包含域名后的接口路径，插件按地址识别协议。模型名称必须是: Enter the complete API URL, including its endpoint path. The add-on selects the protocol from this address. Use an actual model ID supplied by your provider. Presets are editable starting points. API keys are saved in the local OS credential vault when you click OK; enter them again on a new device. Changing a field’s AI connection does not change its prompt.
完整 API Key 仅保存在系统凭证库：Windows 凭据管理器、macOS: Complete API keys are stored only in Windows Credential Manager or macOS Keychain, never in settings or ZIP backups. The field shows the first and last 3 characters; editing hides the key.
无法保存 AI 配置或系统凭证，原密钥已保留。: Cannot save AI settings or OS credentials. Existing keys were retained.
无法读取 AI 配置或系统凭证库，原配置未更改。: Cannot read AI settings or the OS credential vault. Existing settings were not changed.
无法读取系统凭证，请先允许系统访问并重试。原配置未更改。: Cannot read system credentials. Allow OS access and retry. Existing settings were not changed.
确认删除“%s”？现有脚本移入本机回收站，缺失项移除记录。: Delete “%s”? Existing scripts move to the local recycle bin; missing entries are removed.
自动备份：保存修改后，将 AI 连接、字段配置和当前 Python 脚本更新到媒:
Automatic backup updates the media ZIP with saved AI connections and current Python scripts; manual backup uses ZIP import/export. Ordinary preferences and mappings stay in the media configuration.

Dictionary paths, MDX/MDD resources, dictionary JavaScript, conversations and recycled scripts are excluded. Recycled scripts stay local for seven days.

API keys stay in the local OS credential vault and are excluded from sync and backups. Enter keys on another device. Importing a key-free backup does not clear local keys. Export contains saved AI settings only; save edits with OK first.
AI 连接超时，请检查网络、代理和 API 地址，或增加连接超时。: AI connection timed out. Check the network, proxy and API URL, or increase the connection timeout.
等待 AI 回复超时。可增加请求超时，或减少附件和历史消息后重试；本次未自动重发: Timed out waiting for the AI reply. Increase the request timeout or reduce attachments and history before retrying. This request was not resent automatically.
AI 请求超时，请检查网络或增加请求超时；本次未自动重发。: AI request timed out. Check the network or increase the request timeout. This request was not resent automatically.
正在等待 AI；携带 %s 条历史消息，请求正文约 %s 个字符（字符数不是 T: Waiting for AI; including %s history messages, approximately %s request characters (not tokens).
描述希望提取或修复的内容，留空使用默认要求。: Describe what to extract or repair. Leave blank to use the default request.
提取词典已有的释义、音标、例句和发音。结合 HTML、JS 和原脚本分析结构；仅: Extract existing definitions, pronunciation, examples and audio. Analyze the HTML, JS and original parser; repair audio paths only when necessary and preserve working behavior. Do not add unrelated fields or guess missing content.
勾选（默认）：AI 返回 JSON 规则，由插件生成 Python 脚本。适合常:
Checked (default): AI returns JSON rules and the add-on generates Python. Suitable for standard extraction and simple audio repairs, with previews; complex logic is limited by the rule format.

Unchecked: AI generates Python directly. More flexible for nested content and complex processing. Generation checks syntax and structure only; review and debug the code.
注意 Token 消耗：携带历史、源码和调试信息会增加用量。: Mind token usage: including history, source code and debug information increases consumption.
接口格式与 API 地址后缀不一致，请修改格式或地址。: The interface format conflicts with the API URL suffix. Change the format or address.
Messages 使用 system 和 messages；输出上限使用 max: Messages uses system and messages, with max_tokens as the output limit. Check your server documentation for other parameters.
选择服务器支持的 Chat Completions、Responses 或 Me:
Choose Chat Completions, Responses or Messages to match your server. Standard endpoint suffixes are detected automatically; special paths use the selected format. This controls request, authentication and response structures; it does not add support to the server.

History is included only when generating or modifying dictionary scripts, using all or checked items in that window. Ordinary AI flashcard requests do not include this history. Conversation IDs are not used.
勾选：返回 ai-message 和 rules；取消：返回 ai-messag: Checked: return ai-message and rules. Unchecked: return ai-message and complete code. Message-only replies leave the script unchanged.
勾选（默认）：AI 返回解释和完整规则，由插件生成 Python，适合常规提取。:
Checked (default): AI returns an explanation and complete rules; the add-on generates Python for standard extraction.

Unchecked: AI returns an explanation and complete Python for complex processing. Review and debug the code. Both modes allow message-only replies without changing the script.
请先保存当前脚本，再打开编辑。: Save the current script before opening it for editing.
请先生成并保存脚本，再打开编辑。: Generate and save a script before opening it for editing.
已用文本编辑器打开脚本。保存文件后，下次发送或调试会重新读取。: Opened the script in a text editor. Save the file; it will be reread before the next request or debug run.
无法打开文本编辑器，请检查脚本文件和本机编辑器。: Could not open a text editor. Check the script file and installed editor.
文件和当前预览都已修改，请先处理这两个版本，再继续发送或调试。: Both the file and preview have changed. Resolve the two versions before sending or debugging.

自动备份：保存修改后，将 AI 配置和当前 Python 脚本更新到媒体库 ZI:
Automatic backup: saved AI settings and current Python scripts update the media ZIP and sync with Anki media. Manual backup: AI settings and scripts stay local; use ZIP import/export. Ordinary preferences, field mappings and script selections always stay in the media configuration.

Dictionary paths, MDX/MDD files, dictionary JavaScript, conversations and recycled scripts are excluded. Old scripts stay local for seven days and join backups only after restoration.

API keys stay local, are managed by the operating system, and are excluded from configuration uploads and sync. Enter keys on another device. Importing a key-free backup does not clear local keys. Export contains saved settings only; save edits with OK first.
